pages.alt: Thabo imagines his bed as a raft on the sea.
pages.text: Thabo pretends that his bed is a raft on the sea!
pages.transformation: Full PDF page raster, no crop; JPEG quality 88, maximum 1400 px.

pages.alt: Keitu imagines sharks around the bed; Thabo says no.
pages.text: His little sister Keitu says, “Yes! And also! There are sharks.” “No!” says Thabo.
pages.transformation: Full PDF page raster, no crop; JPEG quality 88, maximum 1400 px.

pages.alt: Thabo imagines their school taxi as a spaceship.
pages.text: Thabo pretends that their taxi is a spaceship!
pages.transformation: Full PDF page raster, no crop; JPEG quality 88, maximum 1400 px.

pages.alt: Keitu imagines shooting stars outside the spaceship; Thabo says no.
pages.text: His little sister Keitu says, “Yes! And also! Watch out for shooting stars!” “No,” says Thabo.
pages.transformation: Full PDF page raster, no crop; JPEG quality 88, maximum 1400 px.

pages.alt: Thabo imagines the playground as a jungle.
pages.text: Thabo pretends the playground is a jungle!
pages.transformation: Full PDF page raster, no crop; JPEG quality 88, maximum 1400 px.

pages.alt: Keitu imagines being a lion; Thabo says no.
pages.text: His little sister Keitu says, “Yes! And also! We are lions.” “No,” says Thabo.
pages.transformation: Full PDF page raster, no crop; JPEG quality 88, maximum 1400 px.

pages.alt: Thabo realizes that Keitu has a great idea. Keitu jumps with delight.
pages.text: “Oh!” says Thabo, “Wait! Wow! Yes! That’s a great idea!” “I know!” says Keitu.
pages.transformation: Full PDF page raster, no crop; JPEG quality 88, maximum 1400 px.

pages.alt: Thabo and Keitu both pretend to be lions.
pages.text: Thabo pretends to be a lion! Keitu also pretends to be a lion!
pages.transformation: Full PDF page raster, no crop; JPEG quality 88, maximum 1400 px.

pages.alt: The other children become an imaginary river of crocodiles while Thabo and Keitu float on a log.
pages.text: Thabo pretends the other kids are a river of crocodiles! Keitu says, “Yes! And also! We can jump on this log to float away.”
pages.transformation: Full PDF page raster, no crop; JPEG quality 88, maximum 1400 px.

pages.alt: Thabo and Keitu imagine sliding down a rainbow and watching out for dinosaurs.
pages.text: “Yes! And also!” Thabo says, “We can slide down the rainbow!” Keitu says, “Yes! And also! Watch out for the dinosaurs!”
pages.transformation: Full PDF page raster, no crop; JPEG quality 88, maximum 1400 px.

pages.alt: In a wordless pretend scene, Keitu and Thabo fly among colorful creatures, stars and planets.
pages.transformation: Full PDF page raster, no crop; JPEG quality 88, maximum 1400 px.

pages.alt: Back in the bedroom, Thabo and Keitu smile and say they want to play together again.
pages.text: Thabo says, “I had the best day playing pretend with you.” Keitu says, “And also! We should play again tomorrow!”
pages.transformation: Full PDF page raster, no crop; JPEG quality 88, maximum 1400 px.
